ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity pixels (central white field) to 30% low-intensity pixels (black peripheral margins and trailing edge).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by a low-intensity border along the trailing edge and tips. A distinct low-intensity vertical stripe is located on the left lobe near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular topography with coarse serrations. Left lobe trailing edge features a significant semi-circular indentation. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits fine-grain, high-frequency serrations toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curvature extending from the central median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity (white) circular protrusions (barnacles) on the distal tips of both lobes. Low-intensity circular ring scars are visible across the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple dark, parallel diagonal linear marks (rake marks) on the right lobe and one prominent dark vertical line on the left lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation on the left trailing edge; extensive rake mark scarring on the right lobe; heavy barnacle colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of a prominent vertical pigment line on the left lobe and distinct parallel rake markings on the right lobe surface.
